steps.tx: **Pembrolizumab monotherapy** is the established first-line standard for metastatic NSCLC without driver mutations having PD-L1 tumour proportion score TPS 50% or higher based on **KEYNOTE-024**. In this landmark phase III trial, pembrolizumab achieved a median overall survival exceeding 26 months compared to 13 months with platinum chemotherapy, with 5-year survival rates exceeding 30%.

steps.tx: **Pembrolizumab** plus platinum-pemetrexed significantly improved overall survival over chemotherapy alone in untreated metastatic non-squamous NSCLC regardless of PD-L1 expression in **KEYNOTE-189**. This chemo-immunotherapy doublet established a dramatic overall survival advantage with a hazard ratio of 0.56, while maintenance pemetrexed and pembrolizumab provided sustained antitumour disease control.

steps.tx: In metastatic **squamous NSCLC**, pembrolizumab combined with carboplatin and paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel established an overall survival benefit across all PD-L1 tiers in **KEYNOTE-407**. Adding anti-PD-1 checkpoint inhibition reduced the risk of death by 29%, demonstrating that cytotoxic antigen release synergizes with immune disinhibition across aggressive central squamous histology.

steps.tx: **CheckMate 9LA** proved that dual immunotherapy with **nivolumab and ipilimumab** combined with only two cycles of chemotherapy improves overall survival in advanced NSCLC. Delivering two initial cycles of platinum doublet prevents early progression while intermittent anti-CTLA-4 ipilimumab provides durable T-cell priming, generating a long-term survival plateau irrespective of PD-L1 status.

steps.tx: Consolidation **durvalumab** for 12 months significantly prolongs overall survival following concurrent chemoradiation in unresectable stage III NSCLC in the **PACIFIC trial**. Updated five-year analysis confirmed a median overall survival of 47.5 months with durvalumab versus 29.1 months with placebo, establishing post-chemoradiation checkpoint inhibition as the curative standard of care.

steps.tx: **Maintenance pemetrexed** following four cycles of platinum doublet chemotherapy in non-squamous NSCLC significantly prolonged overall survival in the **PARAMOUNT** trial. Continuation maintenance with single-agent pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every three weeks was well-tolerated with vitamin B12 and folic acid supplementation, suppressing residual occult micrometastases.

Continuation maintenance with single-agent pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every three weeks was well-tolerated with vitamin B12 and folic acid supplementation, suppressing residual occult micrometastases.

right.title: Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Alone

Lacks sustained systemic immunological priming against micrometastases

steps.tx: **Bevacizumab** addition to carboplatin and paclitaxel improves progression-free and overall survival in advanced non-squamous NSCLC, but is contraindicated in squamous histology due to fatal **haemoptysis**. In the ECOG 4599 trial, anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody bevacizumab combined with carboplatin-paclitaxel demonstrated significant survival benefit in non-squamous lung cancer lacking central cavitary lesions.

steps.tx: Second-line **docetaxel** with or without the VEGFR2 antagonist **ramucirumab** is the standard salvage regimen following progression on frontline platinum doublet and immunotherapy. In the REVEL phase III trial, adding ramucirumab to docetaxel significantly prolonged overall survival and objective response in patients with advanced NSCLC refractory to prior platinum regimens.
